what: When a cutout person or animal photo passes 10% above the bottom of the screen, it approaches in steps over 1.5s from 48px up and to the left (or right), firming up as its blur goes 0→.5→.8→1, while the photo jitters at −3, 3, −2.5, 1.5 and −1°. With two photos, from 1.2s on they alternate every half of a 1.8s cycle, moving like a hand-flipped picture book.

options.look: “right” enters from the top right. Default is top left
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Section (one or two) — the first child is the image. The second section overlaps the first

from.where: index.html .sh-obj (hero family · about kid · experience dog · way-here kid) — obj_left/obj_right + frame_anim
